definitions.explanation: An organ in and around the mouth that produces and secretes saliva. Humans have several, including those in the cheeks and under the tongue.

examples.japanese: {唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}から{唾液|だえき}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: Saliva comes out of the salivary glands.

examples.japanese: {梅干|うめぼ}しを{見|み}ると{唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}が{刺激|しげき}される。
examples.english: Seeing a pickled plum stimulates the salivary glands.

examples.japanese: {唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}が{炎症|えんしょう}を{起|お}こすと、{食事|しょくじ}のときに{痛|いた}みを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: When the salivary glands become inflamed, you feel pain while eating.

notes:
Composed of {唾液|だえき} (saliva) + {腺|せん} (gland). An anatomy term for the glands that secrete saliva into the mouth.

USAGE:
- {唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}が{刺激|しげき}される: the salivary glands are stimulated
- {唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}の{炎症|えんしょう}: inflammation of the salivary glands

RELATED WORDS:
- {唾液|だえき}: saliva
- {分泌|ぶんぴつ}: secretion — the process by which a gland releases a substance
